title: Composed proof construction
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, let $V$ be a Boolean PCPP system with input length $n$, proof length $m$, and $r$ query positions, and let a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ have parameter $K$. The map sends an input $w\in\{0,1\}^n$ and proof $p\in\{0,1\}^m$ to a Boolean string of length $m+K s$, where $s$ is the number of seeds of $V$: its first $m$ entries are the entries of $p$, and each remaining entry encodes the corresponding auxiliary sign assigned to a seed and query position.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean PCPP system with input length n, proof length m, and r query positions
A seedwise three-CNF reduction for V with parameter K
caveat: The construction's auxiliary assignment is selected by localAuxiliaryWitness, whose definition is not included in the provided snippet. The exact seed and query indexing also depends on omitted definitions, so the description of the remaining entries is only approximate.
